citations.assessment: The receiving article gives the same alternation and the Menachot citation, and distinguishes the forms Ḥanina and Ḥananyah. The checked digital Bavli gives Ḥanina bar Minyomi speaking to Abaye.
The Bava Metzia phrasing expressly gives Rav Minyomi son of Rav Naḥumi; the corresponding Heilprin article cites the same occurrence.

holds.raw: רב נחומי ואמרי לה רב חנניה בר מניומי
holds.reason: The digital Menachot text gives only Ḥanina bar Minyomi here. The variant reported by Heilprin remains attributable to his source until that witness is collated.
